testcase.name: Scenario: Retain a customized command size while switching tabs: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:741:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain a customized command size while switching tabs ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full 3D Model ribbon visible ✔ And Shell uses the Standard button size in the Modify panel ✔ When the user chooses Large from the Shell button size menu ✔ And the user selects the Tools tab and then returns to 3D Model ✔ Then Shell is still shown as a large button ✔ And its button size menu marks Large as selected ✔ When the user chooses Standard from that menu ✔ Then Shell returns to its standard button presentation ✔ And the part remains visible
